exit 0
--- stdout
Write machine-local toolchain env and optional project activation
Usage:
liza toolchain configure [flags]
Flags:
--agent-tools string AGENT_TOOLS.md handling: auto, skip, or force (default "auto")
--agents string comma-separated provider contracts to activate in --project
--exclude stringArray tool id to exclude (repeatable)
--global-dir string global Liza config directory (default: ~/.liza)
-h, --help help for configure
--include stringArray tool id to include (repeatable)
--install-dir string directory for managed binaries in generated env (default: ~/.local/bin)
--json output result as structured JSON
--profile string tool profile: balanced, lean, or full (default "balanced")
--project string project root where provider contracts and optional indexing hooks should be activated
--write-shell-profile source generated env.sh from the current shell startup file
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
